fit_control_record56.shape: 15 records × 14 U32LE words = 56 bytes per record

initial_word_rules.meaning: current target X/Y/Z raw F32 words

fit_control_record56.marker_stage: quiet and inactive_pair are written from same-callback marker inputs; other fit fields retain their constructed payload
fit_control_record56.numeric_conversion: coordinates are copied as raw F32 words; no Q15 conversion occurs in this record constructor

per_row_order: apply marker insertion: -1 -> new in S0/S1/S2; 0 -> new in S1/S2; 1 -> new in S2 only; other I32 -> no insertion
if updated S0.word1 and S1.word1 are both nonzero, copy complete S0 record to S1
history_delivery.delivered_record: updated S0 for each target slot s

control52_projection.quiet_word: fit word0 is omitted; fit word1 inactive_pair becomes control52 word0
control52_projection.row_identity: target slot s is retained; history never compacts or reorders rows
control52_projection.lineage_sidecar: producer_generation and producer_row are not embedded in the 52 bytes

control16_adapter.regular_rule: control16[s+1] = 13 U32LE words decoded from control52[s]
control16_adapter.regular_rows: target slots 0..14 map to control16 rows 1..15
control16_adapter.unknown_direct_tail_policy: do not import raw/partially-defined direct control52 bytes; unconsumed direct words are the canonical zeros above

target_update_adapter.regular_rule: target_updates[s+1] is the panner result for target slot s
target_update_adapter.same_control_row: regular control52[s] and control16[s+1] retain target slot s; target_updates[s+1] has that same slot label
target_update_adapter.consumers: F04C/F04R/F05JC accept the same committed receipt for callback g; they do not reconstruct targets from equal bytes

domain_separation.purpose: F06OF control16 and F05R56 reader/target update

matrix_adapter.identity_separation: realactive d remains an explicit target-slot vector; canonical D conversion does not rewrite target/control active state; packed/full-permutation/dense-identity views apply only to the stateless mixer

control_rows.same_row_identity: all retain target slot s; none is indexed by compact ActiveOrdinal k

active_matrix_join.realactive_d: explicit list of installed active target slots captured before marker quiet; order is the approved matrix adapter's order
active_matrix_join.slot_to_active_ordinal: for a slot s present in d, its matrix ordinal is its position in d; inactive target slots have no active matrix row for this callback
active_matrix_join.component_output: use the approved adapter's destination row for the same matrix row; SCP16 row is 1 + ComponentOwnerRow
active_matrix_join.control_lookup: independently select control52[s], control16[1+s], and target_updates[1+s] by the target-slot value carried by d

quiet_transition.current_callback: use pre-quiet realactive d for the matrix/component handoff
quiet_transition.after_quiet: next-state only; do not filter or reindex current controls, matrix row labels, or current component accumulation

direct_lfe.audio_generation: g-2 after the F06OF ring is primed; separate from current-g direct metadata

row_mapping.provenance_guard: Control row labels come from target slot and history lineage; matrix-row ordinal, coefficient content, packed permutation, or equal row payload is not an identity source.

generation_domains.name: frontend_callback_generation
generation_domains.owner: F03W callback envelope / F05H producer call
generation_domains.meaning: current staged callback whose stages and output batch are being assembled

generation_domains.name: F06OC_packet_generation
generation_domains.meaning: F06OF/F06OC output packet label; do not substitute for history-row provenance

generation_domains.name: reader_invocation
generation_domains.rule: q = g - 2 when g >= 2; no invocation/receipt at g=0 or g=1

generation_domains.name: regular_history_producer_generation
generation_domains.rule: a delivered regular row keeps the generation of the record currently in history S0; copies and slot transitions copy this tag unchanged
generation_domains.meaning: may be older than batch generation g; never choose it by payload equality

generation_domains.name: direct_target_row_generation
generation_domains.rule: direct row0 provenance is current g
generation_domains.meaning: direct target/control metadata is current even when the direct-LFE audio row is delayed

generation_domains.name: direct_lfe_audio_generation
generation_domains.rule: F06OF LFE ring emits source generation g-2 after priming; SCP16 row0 is the allocated LFE for the current envelope
generation_domains.meaning: audio provenance is separate from control16/direct-target row provenance

order: insert the new record according to marker (-1 to S0/S1/S2, 0 to S1/S2, 1 to S2, other I32 to no insertion)
after insertion, if S0.word1 and S1.word1 are both nonzero, copy the complete S0 record and lineage tag to S1
deliver S0 bytes [4:56] and preserve S0 lineage sidecar
f05h_history_transition.row_rule: history operations are independent for each target slot s=0..14; producer_row remains s

boundary_encodings.adapter_rule: preserve the typed semantic variant internally; encode only at the named boundary. These spellings are not equal identity tokens and none means callback generation 0.

receipt_generation_layout.rows1_to15: regular target slots 0..14; each carries the corresponding delivered S0 producer generation
receipt_generation_layout.payload_persistence: target_updates is callback-local immutable receipt payload; zero persistent target-state bytes

owner_and_transaction.stage_owner: F05R56 owns marker/history, previous-active/target snapshot, reader records/invocation count, and target_updates receipt production
owner_and_transaction.parent_commit_owner: spatial_control model parent commits its persistent state proposal and admits the specialized receipt atomically for the same callback
owner_and_transaction.full_f03w_callback: Use existing staged owner proposals and one parent commit after required stages succeed; do not execute a producer twice for its receipt or create a new transaction framework.
owner_and_transaction.abort_semantics: discard staged proposals at the parent; no stage-local commit or partially admitted receipt
owner_and_transaction.native_boundary: no native global transaction or native receipt schema is claimed

priming: History/marker and target snapshots advance at g0/g1. No reader invocation or target_updates receipt until g>=2.
legacy_admission_boundary: Historical production_allowed=false is not new static model-code permission gating and is not relabelled as execution PASS. Actual integration needs implementation-side validation.
